Privacy Policy

Last updated: 1 November 2026

Marketectify AI (“we”, “the app”) is a tool at social-ai.marketectify.com that helps you plan, write, approve and track social media posts. This page explains what we collect, why, and how you can remove it.

What we collect

  • Account details: your email address and a password (stored only as a secure hash by our login provider, Supabase).
  • Your content: the posts, captions, hashtags, pictures, designs, messages and replies you create or paste into the app.
  • Connected accounts (optional): when you press Connect for YouTube, Facebook or Instagram, we receive the name, ID and profile picture of the channel, Page or account you choose, basic statistics such as subscribers and views, and (for Facebook and Instagram) the comments and messages on the Pages or accounts you connect. We also store the access token the platform gives us so the app can act for you.
  • Usage counters: how many AI requests you made today, so daily limits can work.

We do not sell your data. We do not use it for advertising. We do not collect payment card details in the app.

How we use it

  • To show your dashboard, calendar, inbox and analytics.
  • To publish posts and send replies to the accounts you connected, only when you ask the app to do so.
  • To write drafts with AI. The text you type (for example a topic, or a customer comment you want a reply to) is sent to Google Gemini to generate the answer. We do not send your password or access tokens to the AI.
  • To run and secure the service (for example to stop abuse).

Information from Google (YouTube)

The app’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We use YouTube data only to show you your own channel name and statistics inside the app. We do not share it with anyone else and do not use it to train AI models. You can remove our access any time at myaccount.google.com/permissions. By using the YouTube features you also agree to the YouTube Terms of Service.

Information from Meta (Facebook and Instagram)

When you connect Facebook or Instagram we use the permissions you approve to read your Page or account details, publish posts you approve, and read and answer comments and messages on those accounts. We use this data only to provide those features to you. We do not sell it or use it for advertising. You can remove our access any time in your Facebook settings under Business Integrations (or Apps and Websites), or by pressing Disconnect in the app.

Where it is stored and who processes it

  • Supabase hosts our database, login and file storage. Access tokens are kept in a table that browsers cannot read; only our server functions can.
  • Google (Gemini) processes text for AI drafts.
  • Hostinger serves the website.
  • YouTube and Meta receive the posts and replies you tell the app to send.

How long we keep it

We keep your data while your account is open. When you disconnect an account we delete its stored tokens and details. When you delete your account (see below) we delete your content within 30 days, except where the law requires us to keep something.

Your choices and rights

  • Disconnect any platform in the app at any time.
  • Delete single posts and messages in the app.
  • Ask us to export or delete everything: see how to delete your data.

Security

Data is sent over HTTPS. Each account can only read its own data. No system is perfectly secure, so please use a strong, unique password.

Children

The app is not for children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country).

Changes

If we change this policy we will update the date above. Contact us at marketectify@gmail.com with any question.
